$comment: Anthropic's format, not an Ellipsis contract. Ellipsis does not own, version, or stabilize the shapes in this document — Claude Code does, and it changes them without notice. Only the Ellipsis envelope around the payload (SessionRecord in the OpenAPI spec, and the `claude_stream_json@2.0` record_format that versions this shape) is a stable Ellipsis contract.

CCContentBlockType.description: Kind of assistant content block. Known values: text | tool_use | thinking | redacted_thinking | server_tool_use | web_search_tool_result | mcp_tool_use | mcp_tool_result. Open vocabulary — Anthropic's, not Ellipsis's: treat an unrecognized kind as opaque rather than an error.

CCUnknownStep.description: A line whose `type` — or, for `type: system`, whose `subtype` — is not one of the variants above. Known `type` values: system | assistant | user | result | tool_progress | auth_status | prompt_suggestion | rate_limit_event | conversation_reset | transcript_mirror | command_lifecycle | active_goal | keep_alive (plus `stream_event`, see the root description). Known system `subtype` values: init | hook_started | hook_progress | hook_response | stop_hook_summary | task_started | task_progress | task_updated | task_notification | task_summary | background_tasks_changed | thinking_tokens | output_tokens | thinking | api_retry | api_error | notification | status | commands_changed | compact_boundary | informational | local_command_output | post_turn_summary | session_state_changed | turn_duration | control_request_progress | permission_denied | permission_retry | model_fallback | model_consent_fallback | model_refusal_fallback | model_refusal_no_fallback | memory_saved | memory_recall | agents_killed | away_summary | file_snapshot | scheduled_task_fire | plugin_install | files_persisted | mirror_error | elicitation_complete | worker_shutting_down. This variant exists so the union stays OPEN: Anthropic adds message types on Claude Code's release cadence, and a new one must deserialize as an opaque line rather than fail validation.
CCUnknownStep.title: CCUnknownStep

description: One line of Claude Code's `--output-format stream-json` stdout, exactly as Claude Code wrote it. This is the `payload` of an Ellipsis session record whose `record_format` is `claude_stream_json@2.0` (GET /v1/sessions/{id}/records, GET /v1/sessions/{id}/export, and the `records_append`/`snapshot` frames of WS /v1/sessions/{id}/stream). Ellipsis passes the line through VERBATIM — no transformation, no normalization, no field renaming — and reads only enough of it to fill the record envelope. Anthropic owns this format and it is undocumented, so nothing here is closed: unknown `type`/`subtype` values match `CCUnknownStep`, every object accepts unknown fields, and value enums are published as plain strings. Two things Claude Code emits that are absent from the durable record feed: the variants marked in their own description (liveness ticks Ellipsis drops before ingest), and `type: stream_event` partial-message deltas, which have no variant at all — Ellipsis digests them into ephemeral stream `delta` frames and never persists them (the `system`/`output_tokens` variant is Ellipsis's own throttled summary of them, not a Claude Code line).
title: ClaudeCodeStreamJsonLine
